description: Create, delete, or get a REST application. 'create' generates a REST application from an OpenAPI specification. 'delete' removes the application registration (spec + dispatch); the generated '.impl' implementation class is preserved by design (IRIS %REST.API) — delete it separately if unwanted. 'get' returns the OpenAPI spec for an existing REST application.

name.description: REST application name — an ObjectScript package name (e.g., 'MyApi' or 'MyCompany.MyApi'); it becomes the package of the generated classes. URL-path values like '/myapi' are rejected by IRIS ($ZNAME validation).

namespace.description: Target namespace. Defaults to the server's configured namespace; pass an explicit value to query a different namespace per call without changing the connection default.

server.description: Named server profile to target for this call (from `IRIS_PROFILES`). Omit to use the default server.

spec.description: OpenAPI specification as JSON object or string (required for 'create')

name: iris_interop_rest
title: Manage REST Application
